# URL
https://training.olicyber.it/challenges#challenge-1
# Concept
* decode a message through multiple layers
  * morse code
  * hexadecimal ASCII
  * binary ASCII
  * base64
  * rot13
# Method of solve
* we receive a file with what looks like Morse code, which after decoding, looks like hexadecimal encoding
* after decoding, we see binary
* after binary ASCII encoding, we see a base64 encoded string
* after decoding, we see a rot13 encoded message
* after decoding, we have the flag
* the whole process is recorded here:
```
https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/#recipe=From_Morse_Code('Space','Line%20feed')From_Hex('Auto')From_Binary('Space',8)From_Base64('A-Za-z0-9%2B/%3D',true,false)ROT13(true,true,false,13)&
```
